game_concept: A action defense set in The Kingdom – Throne Hall, the throne hall of the kingdom: the knight must handle mischievous imps while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Uninitialized Hunt: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before mischievous imps exploit the gap.
theme: The Kingdom – Throne Hall: the throne hall of the kingdom
core_gameplay_loop: In Throne Hall, repeat each round: Find variables used before assignment and fix them before mischievous imps exploit the gap. Each round, mischievous imps strike the signal beacon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the bugs_fixed value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the signal beacon from mischievous imps in Throne Hall: keep the bugs_fixed meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: bugs_fixed drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 5 (applied tier): Uninitialized Hunt
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Uninitialized Hunt' (Week 1 slot 15), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Throne Hall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bugs_fixed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous imps in Throne Hall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while bugs_fixed > 0.
